measurement.note: Complete open sprint road limits estimated from31 cross-sections on the pinned licensed satellite mosaic (approximately0.71m ground pixels). Signed edge positions read in native and rectified crops; roughly1-2m reading precision, not surveyed accuracy. Limits follow the main dark paved road, excluding separate grass/horse-racing paths and adjoining apron where distinguishable. Access openings near stations0,60-80,180 and400 and small shadow/paint ambiguities remain inferred joins. Intervals follow the existing smoothed source normals and linearly interpolate these measured signed offsets; intermediate positions are not independent observations. Original OSM trace, provisional event direction, start/finish and timing data remain unchanged. This is an open start-to-finish run with no artificial closing road. Curbs illustrative, terrain approximate and banking unknown.

measurement.note: Complete sparse road limits estimated from20 native-image cross-sections plus exact closure, on the independently digitized image-source route. Positions read in native and rectified crops; faded paint, pit/apron joins, blue runoff and imagery blur limit reading to roughly1-2m, not surveyed accuracy. Main dark-pavement limits exclude blue runoff where distinguishable; joins near the western return and inner S remain interpolated estimates. Intermediate offsets follow the corrected source normals and are not independent edge observations. No operator nominal width or lap length is fitted. Original OSM trace remains in research evidence; original missing timing remains missing. Curbs illustrative, terrain estimated and banking unknown.
